what: *** THE PRIZE LEAD WAS ALREADY ANSWERED ***

result: *** AVELINO IS ATTACHED TO SANCHO, AND HAS BEEN FOR WEEKS ***
what was already published: data/compound-surname-sweep.tsv has said since 14 September that *** no record names Avelino's own parents, so he is still not shown to be Sancho's son and the Traibel branch stays unattached. ***
what it means: *** HIS REGISTER ROW CITES TWO BAPTISMS OF HIS CHILDREN AT SAN FRANCISCO DE ASIS, 12 MARCH 1858, NAMING HIS PARENTS. *** He is Avelino LERENA Fernandez, son of Sancho, born about 1815, died at Montevideo *** 23 August 1890. *** The note was stale for a month. *** It is scoped - 'no record names his PARENTS' - so the new check-nulls gate does not catch it, and that is worth knowing about the gate as much as about the note. *** Corrected in place rather than deleted.

what: *** AND THE SECOND WIFE IS NOT A SECOND WIFE ***
the source: Cordon christenings naming Avelino Lerena with CELEDONIA VILLADEMOROS, 1866-1870
result: *** ALREADY HELD - THEY BELONG TO HIS SON ***
what was already published: Avelino x Ambrosia Traibel have children from 1841 to 1863. A second household with children 1866-1870 looks like a remarriage.
what it means: *** It is AVELINO EDUARDO LERENA Traibel, the son, married to Celedonia VILLADEMOROS - both already in this register, with four children and a note on the spellings of her surname. *** Checked before it was written up. *** Three times in one day a thing that looked new was already here, which is the strongest argument this archive has for reading itself first. ***

what: *** ONE RECORD THE REGISTER CANNOT ACCOUNT FOR ***
result: *** AVELINO LERENA, BURIED 2 JUNE 1860, CEMENTERIO CENTRAL DE MONTEVIDEO ***
what was already published: The Avelino this archive holds died 23 August 1890, and his son Avelino Eduardo was fathering children in 1866.
what it means: *** So a third Avelino Lerena was buried at the Cementerio Central in 1860, and no person in this register answers to it. *** Most likely an infant son named for his father, which this family does constantly - but that is a guess and it is filed as one. *** FIND A GRAVE IS A DERIVATIVE INDEX, NOT AN ACT ***, and the entry carries a photograph which this archive will cite and not republish. The burial register itself has not been opened.

what: *** AND THE CORDON ITSELF IS STILL UNREAD ***
result: *** FOUR LEADS WORKED, ONE OF 470 PAGES TURNED ***
what was already published: The parish was sized on 12 October and the errand left open with the number against it.
what it means: *** Of the four leads named then: the Avelino one is answered and was already answered; the Villademoros one was already held; the PARAGUAYAN Manuel Antonio Lerena and the CARVALLO LERENA household are UNTOUCHED. *** The errand stays open. *** What this session actually bought at the Cordon was three corrections and one unexplained burial, which is a fair afternoon and is not a reading of the parish. ***
